items.text: A heartfelt thank you to our players! We’ve seen your feedback, your reviews, your messages - and it has shaped how we’ve continued to support the game. For a small team like ours, this kind of engagement genuinely means the world to us. We hope you enjoy the update and look forward to see what you create with the new photo mode
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45650707/eac00a87afe6a806298c55deae0970263e571dea.jpg"]
Patch 2.03 is live!

This update brings a round of polish and fixes across the game, including updated HUD improvements, minor animation updates, visual and audio fixes, and overall performance and stability improvements. We’ve also addressed GPU-related issues (including AMD cards) and made optimizations across multiple chapters.

As this is our last patch before the holidays, we want to take a moment to say thank you to everyone who’s played, shared feedback, and supported the game so far - it genuinely means a lot to the team💙
We’ll be taking a short holiday break, but more updates and improvements are planned after the holidays, so stay tuned. Until then, enjoy the patch and happy holidays!🎄✨
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45650707/a6e2618981035b9262f683eabb82d51c643a1293.jpg"]

This week's patch brings several fixed to issues players have been reporting with the Enhanced Edition update, most notably to crashes on 5000 and 6000 series AMD CPUs, as well as to a couple of relics that weren't behaving as intended.
White attacks from enemies are now interrupted by Ryn’s Heavy Attack.
Fixed an issue where the color of a ward would change when reloading.
Tutorials now show correct bindings if the player has remapped them.
Removed a duplicate relic collectible.
Tessellation can now be toggled on and off.
Cor no longer gets stuck on the slides in Chapter 1.
Enemies no longer get stuck on edges and cliffs after shifting during combat.
Fixed an issue where Abram’s Buddy Boost would break causing player to not be able to proceed forward.
Fixed an issue where Abram’s behaviour before Buddy Boost would break the character causing visual issues.
Fixed an issue where the wrong decal texture would cause Ryn to fall off the path.
Removed the ability to the Dalsman introduction cutscene, as it was causing issues.
Added a constant Glimmerweave counter to the UI.
Abram no longer gets left behind in chapter 3 due to him being stuck in the “exploration” state.
Added ultrawide support to the Sarcophagus scene in Chapter 4.
Having the Heart of the Reckless relic equipped no longer causes the player to die during the drain introduction in chapter 1.
The boat is no longer affected by the time swap ability in chapter 9.
Ryn and Abram are no longer misaligned in chapter 3 cinematics.
Disabled certain options on 5000 and 6000 series AMD GPUs that were causing crashes on start-up.
Added blockers to stop Ryn from dashing to enemies in air.
Abram no longer gets stuck in environments during specific finishers in combat.
Added a blocker so Ryn is no longer able to drain when sliding into combat.
Effects and texture quality is now saved correctly.
Cor no longer walks off of platforms while they’re being shifted.
Fixed an issue where Ryn would get stuck while mantling over a decal in chapter 3.
Abram now does not disappear or get stuck during a buddy boost in chapter 6.
Reloading during boat entry now interrupts the entry and you reload to the docks instead of back into the animation.
Frame generation no longer resets when opening up the game.
Azure Conversion Stone relic no longer damages Ryn while out of combat.
Rune of Aegis relic now works as intended.
Heart of Recklessness relic now works as intended.
Fixed several instances of FPS dropping throughout the game.
Adjusted several death volumes throughout the game.
Fixed an issue with one of the Relics where damage reduction bonus would be incorrectly calculated.
Resolved an issue with the text on one of the Relics displaying the wrong percentage modifiers
Fixed Azure conversion stone Relic being able to kill you while using a cairn if the mana you gained was more than your current mana
Ensure Azure conversion stone Relic doesn’t convert health into mana when you are out of combat
Fixed an issue where the camera could lock in place if you skipped a Vista scene while the camera was transitioning
DLSS Plugin Updated to newest version
Certain POIs fixed to now support widescreen
Fixed an issue where if you reset the game as Ryn was entering the boat, upon reload you could become stuck in a strange state
Resolved an issue where changing outfits could result in the visuals indicating you have an active charge to disappear

releases.displayName: Free Enhanced Edition update available now!

items.text: For the last few months, we’ve been going through the mountains of feedback you guys have given us since release. We’ve been seeing what we can do to improve on frequently highlighted points of frustration; what we can do to add in features you felt were missing for the game to feel complete. And today, we’re happy to release the culmination of that work, with this Enhanced Edition update for Echoes of the End.
The full patch notes will be linked below, but some highlights include:
A brand new equipment system that lets you mix and match cosmetic outfits with relics that modify your stats and abilities.
A combat overhaul that takes the changes already made in our first combat update and pushes them even further.
A complete rework of Ryn’s core animation set, designed to tackle the feeling of “floatiness” and detachment from the world.
A redesign of the game’s first chapter and tutorial experience, designed to get you into the flow of the story quicker.
A reduction in menial interactions.
New Game+
And so much more.
Alternatively, you can check out the video here for a deeper dive into everything the Enhanced Edition has to offer.

We want to extend our deepest thanks to everyone who played the game and took a moment to leave us your thoughts and feedback. Your support has been invaluable in helping us make Echoes of the End the best it can be, and we want you to know that we will continue listening as we move forward.
Whether you’re returning to Aema or stepping into it for the first time, we hope you enjoy the Enhanced Edition as much as we’ve enjoyed creating it.
Patch 1.05 is now live on all platforms, bringing a number of fixes and smaller updates to the player experience. Check out the full patch notes below, and keep the feedback coming!
Meanwhile, the team is working towards a substantial update that we’re very excited to share with you all in the near future. Keep your eyes open for more information on that, coming soon!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45650707/17b7a5156b16c22d73362f0fed8d6f92fc0f67c7.jpg"]

We've just published Patch 1.04 which brings forward highly requested features including HDR support, chapter select and toggles to hints. In addition, by popular request, we've also reduced the damage taken from enemies for story mode.
We've also fixed a number of defects reported to us. We are continuing to monitor your feedback and plan to release a bigger update in the coming weeks!
See you in Aema!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45650707/39bdeeec740463b8727b0c47432c5c97d041ca28.jpg"]
We've just published Patch 1.03, which brings forward an array of fixes for reported issues, as well as some smaller overall improvements.

Meanwhile, we continue working on a larger set of updates and quality of life features coming in next week. We had aimed to have HDR added to all hardware with this patch, but had to delay it to next week due to some incorrect interactions between HDR and colour-blind settings.
We will also be sharing a roadmap very soon to provide you with a good overview of the incoming updates and improvements ahead, incorporating your feedback and suggestions.
In the meantime, see you in Aema!

releases.displayName: Update - Combat improvements and patch notes

items.text: Tomorrow marks ten days since we released Echoes of the End, and what a whirlwind it’s been! We’ve been absolutely thrilled with the support and reception we’ve received so far, but make no mistake, we’re listening to your feedback, too, and this patch, now live, is the biggest we’ve done yet.

This update includes some considerable improvements to combat to make it feel more fluid and responsive, including the ability to cancel out of attacks into a dodge or parry, and some changes to how the camera and slow motion effects react to your actions.
You can check out the full patch notes below (minor spoiler alert), and keep your eyes peeled for a video going into more detail on some of these changes on our YouTube channel very soon!

releases.displayName: Update - Patch and combat update coming on Thursday

items.text: Tomorrow marks a week since the launch of Echoes of the End, but that doesn’t mean we’ve been resting on our laurels! After last week's updates, the team has been hard at work reviewing more of your feedback on combat and other issues you've encountered since launch, and we’ll be rolling out two more updates this week in response.

The first, coming tomorrow (please refer to the update at the bottom of the post), focuses on stability and polish, fixing several crashes, soft locks, and other technical issues players have reported, such as missing terrain on certain hardware. You can expect improvements to a few of our boss encounters as well, with Skuggi in particular receiving balance tweaks (as well as a fix to a rare bug causing players to not receive a skill point upon defeating him), and Zara’s shield gaining clearer visuals and sound effects to communicate its function to the player. Additional improvements include more forgiving dodge timing, larger subtitles, and some chapter-specific fixes to prevent unintended skips or progression blocks.

Full patch notes will follow when the patch releases tomorrow, but the changes to dodge timing in particular are the first step in a more thorough combat update arriving on Thursday, that we believe will go far to address some of the issues players have been reporting there.

Alongside these updates, we're looking into other areas that matter to you guys (such as fixes to ultrawide cutscenes, HDR and DLSS framegen), and will keep you updated on each of these as we move forward.
Thanks for all of your support so far, and we hope you continue to enjoy Ryn's story as we keep working to improve your experience with the game.

UPDATE: We were unfortunately not able to test the patch for today (Tuesday) to a point where we were satisfied with pushing it out to the public. Instead of risking a patch that may introduce further issues, we are combining it with Thursday's larger combat update. We thank you for the understanding and support you've shown so far, and hope you will continue to enjoy your journeys through Aema as we continue to work to improve your experience with Echoes of the End.

releases.displayName: Update - A fix to shader-related stuttering

items.text: As we mentioned in our patch notes yesterday, we've been hard at work implementing and testing a fix to the shader precompilation issues that have caused some players to experience hitches and stuttering during gameplay, especially in the game's earlier chapters. Today's update (which is now live!) should go far to address these issues, but we encourage you to let us know if you still encounter hitches during gameplay after updating.
Thank you all once again for all your support, and we hope you continue to enjoy your time in Aema!

The day 3 patch is live! This patch addresses some of the critical issues that have been reported since the game launched a couple of days ago. You can expect another patch coming tomorrow addressing the shader precompilation issues that have been causing visual hitches for some players, in particular in the game's earliest chapters.
Check out the full patch notes below!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45650707/a0acae6dbaecf550a5c1ca372cf0dcc5fc0a3b98.png"]

releases.displayName: Update - Patch tomorrow and performance fixes Friday

items.text: It’s been a busy couple of days here at the Myrkur Games studio, and we want to start by thanking you all for the incredible support you’ve shown the game! As we mentioned in our last post, we’ve been keeping a close eye on the performance issues some players have reported, particularly hitches and stutters in the PC build caused by shaders not being captured correctly for precompilation. We have found the source of the problem, which should address stutter issues caused by shaders being compiled during play.

Tomorrow we’ll be implementing and testing these changes, and we’re confident we can deliver them to you on Friday, just in time for a smooth weekend of gaming. In the meantime, you can expect another patch tomorrow addressing several other reported issues.
Thank you again for joining us on this journey. We hope you continue to enjoy your time in Aema!
As it turns out, the day 1 patch is already live! Don't worry if you just downloaded the game, it was updated before you even bought it so you shouldn't have to worry about downloading an update.

releases.displayName: Showcase - An update to combat animations

items.text: It's been just about two weeks since the gameplay trailer dropped and we've been absolutely thrilled to see the response so far! We want to thank you all for watching and taking the time to comment, and to show you that we’re taking your feedback seriously as we polish our way to release.

Many of you wanted to see combat feel faster and more fluid, and we’ve been hard at work making that happen. We’re excited to share this look at some of the updates we've been doing to combat animations and we’ll make sure to keep refining and listening to your feedback right up until launch.
We love hearing what you think, so please, keep the comments coming. And make sure you check back here tomorrow for another one of our semi-regular dev vlogs!
Echoes of the End releases August 12th. Wishlist the game now and follow this community hub for all the latest updates!
